episodes.name: The Engagement
episodes.overview: Jerry reneges on his pact with George to be more like "grown-up men"; Newman takes care of a barking dog that keeps Elaine awake.

episodes.name: The Postponement
episodes.overview: Elaine shares her feelings about George with the wrong person. Meanwhile, George discovers the power of tears.

episodes.name: The Maestro
episodes.overview: A maestro impresses Elaine, jeopardizes Kramer's lawsuit and makes Jerry curious about housing in Italy.

episodes.name: The Wink
episodes.overview: George's involuntary winking is misinterpreted by many, and prompts Kramer to seek a favor from Yankee Paul O'Neill; Jerry tries to hide his distaste for meat from Elaine's cousin.

episodes.name: The Hot Tub
episodes.overview: An Olympic athlete stays at Elaine's; George picks up colloquialisms from Houston Astros execs; Kramer installs a hot tub at his pad.

episodes.name: The Soup Nazi
episodes.overview: Cooing between Jerry and his girlfriend irritates George; Elaine runs afoul of a soup vendor; Kramer loses Elaine's armoire to muggers.

episodes.name: The Secret Code
episodes.overview: George dines with Elaine's boss; Jerry's sleeping foot costs him a commercial; Kramer gives traffic advice to firemen.

episodes.name: The Pool Guy
episodes.overview: An acquaintance latches on to Jerry; George objects to Susan's relationship with his pals; Kramer's new phone number brings many wrong numbers.

episodes.name: The Sponge
episodes.overview: Elaine holds a monopoly on the contraceptive devices that Susan prefers; Kramer refuses to wear a ribbon on his AIDS walk.

episodes.name: The Gum
episodes.overview: Kramer is overprotective of a friend who had a breakdown after dating Elaine; a former neighbor is worried about George's mental stability.

episodes.name: The Rye
episodes.overview: George's parents meet Susan's; Elaine fears her enthusiasm may have scared off the musician she's dating; Kramer drives a hansom cab, but feeds his steed bad fuel.

episodes.name: The Caddy
episodes.overview: Kramer sues Elaine's friend for sinking his golf career; George's apparent work ethic impresses his bosses.

episodes.name: The Seven
episodes.overview: Kramer demands compensation from Elaine for his chiropractic effort; Jerry's flame always wears the same outfit.

episodes.name: The Cadillac (1)
episodes.overview: George becomes obsessed with Marisa Tomei after he's told he's her type; Jerry gives his father a Cadillac.

episodes.name: The Cadillac (2)
episodes.overview: George has a meeting with Marisa Tomei; the Cadillac Jerry buys his father sparks trouble for his dad.

episodes.name: The Shower Head
episodes.overview: Elaine fails a drug test--twice--and loses her job; Jerry talks about his Uncle Leo on "The Tonight Show."

episodes.name: The Doll
episodes.overview: Susan's friend interferes with Jerry's planned jokes; Susan's doll reminds George of his mother; Frank Costanza builds a billiard room.

episodes.name: The Friars Club
episodes.overview: Elaine suspects a co-worker is faking a hearing impairment; Jerry makes a faux pas at the Friars Club after comic Pat Cooper sponsors him for membership.

episodes.name: The Wig Master
episodes.overview: Jerry gets miffed when a salesman hits on Elaine while she's with him; George suspects hookers are conducting business in his parked car.

episodes.name: The Calzone
episodes.overview: George gets his boss, George Steinbrenner, hooked on calzones, then loses his supplier; Kramer warms to clothing fresh from the dryer.

episodes.name: The Bottle Deposit (1)
episodes.overview: Jerry has an argument with his mechanic; Newman becomes obsessed with Michigan's recycling program; Elaine goes to an auction for her boss.

episodes.name: The Bottle Deposit (2)
episodes.overview: While driving a postal truck, Kramer and Newman spot Jerry's stolen car, containing Elaine's JFK golf clubs.

episodes.name: The Wait Out
episodes.overview: Jerry and Elaine see opportunities for themselves when George causes a couple to separate; Kramer can't remove his new jeans.

episodes.name: The Invitations
episodes.overview: Jerry falls for a woman much like himself; George wants out of his wedding, and his fiancée doesn't want Elaine in the wedding party.
